title: AuditChain
description: SAIA-Class S schema defining the immutable, hash-linked audit chain for Beast System 3.0. Ensures chronological integrity, tamper-evidence, and cryptographic continuity of all audit log entries.

chainId.description: Unique identifier for this audit chain instance.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit chain was initialized.

entries.description: Ordered list of audit log entries forming the immutable chain.

chainMetadata.description: Metadata describing the chain's configuration and operational parameters.
